title: Balanced ordinary signed-line scalar tensor comparison
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme with its small pro-etale site and chosen universes as in [def-pur-ordinary-line-scalar-data]. Let $\alpha:R\to S$ be a map of commutative ring sheaves, $p$ a universal scalar presentation, and $L,K$ module sheaves over $R,S$. For each $m\in\mathbf Z$ fix $B_m:M_m\otimes_R S\cong N_m$, where $M_m=L^{[m]}$ and $N_m=K^{[m]}$. There is a natural isomorphism $o_m:E_p(-\otimes_R M_m)\cong E_p(-)\otimes_S N_m$ of ordinary module-sheaf functors. Its forward map sends $s\otimes(x\otimes y)$ to $(s\otimes x)\otimes B_m(1\otimes y)$; its inverse sends $(s\otimes x)\otimes B_m(q\otimes y)$ to $sq\otimes(x\otimes y)$, using the fixed sheafification pure sections and object-equation transport of [def-pur-ordinary-line-scalar-data]. No local-freeness, flat ring-map, or derived-category comparison hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Construct each component from the existing scalar extension binary tensor core, transport the ordinary sheaf tensors through their sheafification identifications, and compose with B_m on the second factor. The component formula follows from the core generator formula.

Use the normalized ordinary scalar adjunction to test naturality on pure tensors; both maps apply the given module morphism to x. The inverse identity and bilinearity move q to the first tensor factor and multiply s and q, giving the inverse formula.

theorem ordinary_scalar_line_balanced
    (α : R ⟶ S) (p : SuccessiveDerivedQuotient.Presentation.{t + 1, t, max a (t + 1), w}
      (J := Scheme.ProEt.topology X) α)
    (L : Modules.{t, a} X R) (K : Modules.{t, a} X S)
    (B : ∀ m : ℤ, changeOfRingsOfUniverses.{t, t + 1, max a (t + 1), max a (t + 1)}
      (J := Scheme.ProEt.topology X) α (power.{t, a} L m) ≅ power.{t, a} K m)
    : ∃ o : ∀ m : ℤ, tensor.{t, a} L m ⋙ p.ordinary ≅
        p.ordinary ⋙ tensor.{t, a} K m,
      (∀ (m : ℤ) (M : Modules.{t, a} X R) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (x : M.val.obj U) (y : (power.{t, a} L m).val.obj U) (s : S.obj.obj U),
        ((o m).hom.app M).val.app U
          (scalar.{t, a, w} p ((tensor.{t, a} L m).obj M) U s
            (LineUnbounded.pureTensor.{t, a} X R M (power.{t, a} L m) U x y)) =
        LineUnbounded.pureTensor.{t, a} X S (p.ordinary.obj M) (power.{t, a} K m) U
          (scalar.{t, a, w} p M U s x)
          ((B m).hom.val.app U (scalarExtensionSection α (power.{t, a} L m) U 1 y))) ∧
      (∀ (m : ℤ) (M : Modules.{t, a} X R) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (x : M.val.obj U) (y : (power.{t, a} L m).val.obj U) (s q : S.obj.obj U),
        ((o m).inv.app M).val.app U
          (LineUnbounded.pureTensor.{t, a} X S (p.ordinary.obj M) (power.{t, a} K m) U
            (scalar.{t, a, w} p M U s x)
            ((B m).hom.val.app U (scalarExtensionSection α (power.{t, a} L m) U q y))) =
        scalar.{t, a, w} p ((tensor.{t, a} L m).obj M) U (s * q)
          (LineUnbounded.pureTensor.{t, a} X R M (power.{t, a} L m) U x y))
